```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Force the Knit directory to be the Project Root
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here) 
library(ggprism)
library(fs) # Added fs for cleaner directory management

# Define absolute paths using here()
discomfort_path <- here("Data", "raw", "feasibility", "discomfort_data.xlsx")
completion_path <- here("Data", "raw", "feasibility", "raw_completion.csv")
fig_path        <- here("Figures", "feasibility")

# Create the folder at the root level (fs::dir_create is safer/cleaner)
if (!fs::dir_exists(fig_path)) fs::dir_create(fig_path)
```

# 1. Combined Feasibility Analysis: Discomfort, Completion, and Streaks
```{r feasibility-analysis}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)

# 1. Load and Clean Data
# Using the anchored paths defined in your setup
discomfort_raw <- read_xlsx(here(discomfort_path)) %>%
  mutate(discomfort_rating = as.numeric(as.character(discomfort_rating)))

raw_feasibility_data <- read_csv(here(completion_path))

# 2. DISCOMFORT SUMMARY
discomfort_stats <- discomfort_raw %>% 
  summarise(
    Metric = "Discomfort Rating (0-10)",
    Value = median(discomfort_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dispersion = paste0("IQR: ", IQR(discomfort_rating, na.rm = TRUE), 
                        " [", quantile(discomfort_rating, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
                        "-", quantile(discomfort_rating, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), "]")
  )

# 3. COMPLETION SUMMARY (Participant Level)
participant_completion <- raw_feasibility_data %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    percent_complete = (sum(complete == 1) / n()) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

completion_stats <- participant_completion %>%
  summarise(
    Metric = "Overall Participant Completion (%)",
    Value = mean(percent_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dispersion = paste0("SD: ", round(sd(percent_complete, na.rm = TRUE), 2))
  )

# 4. CONSECUTIVE STREAK ANALYSIS (Nights 3-9)
streak_stats <- raw_feasibility_data %>%
  filter(night >= 3 & night <= 9) %>%
  arrange(id, night) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  # Logic: Identify groups of consecutive identical 'complete' values
  mutate(streak_id = cumsum(complete != lag(complete, default = first(complete)))) %>%
  filter(complete == 1) %>%
  group_by(id, streak_id) %>%
  summarise(streak_len = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(max_streak = max(streak_len), .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise(
    Metric = "Max Consecutive Nights (Nights 3-9)",
    Value = mean(max_streak, na.rm=TRUE),
    Dispersion = paste0("SD: ", round(sd(max_streak, na.rm=TRUE), 2))
  )

# 5. COMBINE INTO FINAL SUMMARY TABLE
feasibility_master_table <- bind_rows(discomfort_stats, completion_stats, streak_stats)

# Display results
knitr::kable(feasibility_master_table, digits = 2, 
             caption = "Table 1: Participant Feasibility, Completion, and Adherence Metrics")

# Export for your records
write_csv(feasibility_master_table, here("Output/feasibility/feasibility_summary_stats.csv"))
```

# 2. Feasibility Visualization: Completion Rates, Discomfort Ratings, and Streaks

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(here)

completion_summary <- raw_feasibility_data %>%
  summarise(
    complete_count = sum(complete == 1),
    incomplete_count = sum(complete == 0)
  ) %>%
  gather(key = "status", value = "count") %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)

completion_summary_7 <- raw_feasibility_data %>%
  filter(night >= 3 & night <= 9) %>%
  summarise(
    complete_count = sum(complete == 1),
    incomplete_count = sum(complete == 0)
  ) %>%
  gather(key = "status", value = "count") %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)

# 1. Panel A: Overall Rate (Pie) - Cleaner & Bigger
p_overall <- ggplot(completion_summary, aes(x = "", y = count, fill = status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 5) + 
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("complete_count" = "skyblue", "incomplete_count" = "salmon"))

# 2. Panel B: Nights 3-9 (Pie)
p_subset <- ggplot(completion_summary_7, aes(x = "", y = count, fill = status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 5) + 
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("complete_count" = "skyblue", "incomplete_count" = "salmon"))

# 3. Panel C: Nightly Completion (Bar)
p_bar <- raw_feasibility_data %>%
  group_by(night) %>%
  summarise(freq = sum(complete == 1) / n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(night), y = freq)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue", color = "black", width = 0.8) + 
  labs(x = "Night", y = "Proportion Completed") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1.1)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())

# 4. Panel D: Discomfort Rating (Histogram)
p_discomfort <- discomfort_raw %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = discomfort_rating)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#a494d2", color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:10) +
  labs(x = "Discomfort Rating (0-10)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())

# 5. ARRANGE IN A 2x2 GRID
# (Top row: Pies) / (Bottom row: Bar & Histogram)
final_composite <- (p_overall + p_subset) / (p_bar + p_discomfort) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

# 6. Save and Print
print(final_composite)

ggsave(here("Output/feasibility/feasibility_results.png"), 
       final_composite, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
